feeds.title: Bachata Passion Blog
feeds.description: Blog of Steffie from Bachata Passion with articles about the dance school, bachata, bachata lessons, dance lessons, and much more. Bachata Passion is not only the largest Bachata Dance School in the Netherlands. This is the place to be to learn everything about Bachata! We offer workshops, boot camps, weekly classes, shows, and entertainment in Bachata.

feeds.title: Saboramelao » Bachata
feeds.description: The following section of Saboramelao features articles on Bachata. This blog will bring you the most exciting parts of music and dances such as salsa, bachata, and kizomba. You will also discover new songs, the stories of extraordinary personalities from the world of music and dance, and many other surprises.

feeds.title: Caliente Dance Studio Blog
feeds.description: Read our very interesting articles about Salsa, Bachata, Kizomba, and Latin Dance in General. We are Ali and Janey, the co-founders of Caliente Dance Studio in Singapore. We are passionate individuals who celebrate life through dancing and traveling. Our mission is to provide tailored Salsa, Bachata, and Kizomba classes that will improve your fitness level, and mind-body connection, express your creativity, improve your self-confidence, and most importantly, a friendly place for you to meet new friends and have fun while picking up a new hobby!

feeds.title: S&P Bachata Blog
feeds.description: We are Philipp and Sarah. A passionate dance couple from the southern Bavarian town of Augsburg. In total, we share many years of dance experience and are always thirsty to learn more and expand our very personal dance styles. Combining sensual bachata moves with the flavor of our own urban Hip-hop background, we have begun to develop our own bachata style.

feeds.title: Bachata Embassy Blog
feeds.description: Check out our latest Bachata Embassy Dance Blog Here! Keep up with the latest Bachata News & Guides Worldwide! The Bachata Embassy is an International Bachata Organization that was established in 2021. This organization is a diverse, cohesive International Bachata Organization to help elevate all genres of Bachata Dance and Music under one main Bachata Umbrella.
